name: ga4-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for Google Analytics 4: reports, realtime, funnels, pivots, metadata catalog and admin lists across the Data and Admin APIs.

tools.name: ga4_list_account_summaries
tools.description: List every GA4 account and its child properties accessible to this service account

tools.name: ga4_get_property_details
tools.description: Full metadata for a single GA4 property

tools.name: ga4_list_data_streams
tools.description: List all data streams (web, iOS, Android) on a GA4 property

tools.name: ga4_list_custom_dimensions
tools.description: List custom dimensions configured on a GA4 property

tools.name: ga4_list_custom_metrics
tools.description: List custom metrics configured on a GA4 property

tools.name: ga4_list_key_events
tools.description: List key events (formerly conversions) on a GA4 property

tools.name: ga4_list_audiences
tools.description: List audiences defined on a GA4 property

tools.name: ga4_list_google_ads_links
tools.description: List Google Ads links attached to a GA4 property

tools.name: ga4_list_property_annotations
tools.description: List reporting annotations on a GA4 property

tools.name: ga4_run_access_report
tools.description: Audit log of who read what on a GA4 property, last 12 months

tools.name: ga4_get_metadata
tools.description: Fetch the full GA4 dimension and metric catalog for a property

tools.name: ga4_run_report
tools.description: Run a GA4 standard report, the workhorse tool

tools.description: Run up to 5 GA4 reports in a single round trip
